question: Does the endpoint-positive independent pre-GELU orthogonal frame improve causal from-scratch 124M next-token training beyond the same generated-c_proj model with only the accepted post-GELU rotations?
scientific_scope: one matched 124M 0.5TPP parent/candidate comparison; no broad ladder, learning-rate sweep, scalar-gain change, residual HyperConnection, or PRO6 execution

evidence_chain.dense_trajectory: The registered dense 124M Muon trajectory found locally low temporal PC dimension but high matrix-rank terminal displacement and layer-specific tangents; this rules out interpreting low temporal PCA rank as a single shared linear subspace.
evidence_chain.bilateral_task_endpoint: Task-conditioned hidden/output rotations improved all three registered validation seeds by 0.0083 to 0.0101 CE, while scalar gains were null.
evidence_chain.pregelu_task_endpoint: With the accepted post-GELU rotations fixed, an independent folded pre-GELU frame improved the three registered validation seeds by 0.0083 to 0.0101 CE at update 120.
evidence_chain.causal_requirement: Endpoint optimization establishes local task capacity but not from-scratch trainability. Only the matched pair below can promote the structure.

implementation.folding: For row-vector activations h=xW^T, the pre-GELU frame hR is evaluated by folding R into W^T before F.linear; cached execution retains exact VJP to c_fc and frame coordinates without materializing a 3072x3072 dense matrix.

shared_training_protocol.optimizer: Muon for selected matrix parameters plus AdamW fallback
shared_training_protocol.schedule: 10-update warmup then cosine decay to 0.00024 at update 238
shared_training_protocol.save_policy: exact-resume checkpoint at every registered evaluation and terminal update; retain terminal checkpoint and provenance hashes

parent.difference: shared structure only; no pre-GELU frame

candidate.difference: add an identity-initialized pre-GELU frame in every layer

performance_gate.requirement: Each exact immutable arm config must independently pass the real-training MFU preflight on its selected exclusive Y400 GPU before scientific training.
performance_gate.measurement: conventional 6N active-model FLOPs divided by the same-GPU empirical BF16 tensor-core GEMM peak
performance_gate.prelaunch_amendment: The first immutable b32/g8 candidate measurement was 19.6261 percent MFU, below the gate, while its matched parent measured 22.1625 percent. Before either scientific arm ran, both arms were changed together to b64/g4. This preserves 262144 tokens per update and all seeds while amortizing one cache prepare/flush over larger microbatches.
performance_gate.polling: foreground/direct polling only; no watchdog, queue entry, callbacks, or heartbeat for these short runs

decision_rule.primary_metric: terminal fixed-window validation cross entropy at update 238
decision_rule.promote: candidate terminal val CE is at least 0.020 lower than the matched parent, both runs exit cleanly, and neither shows numerical instability
decision_rule.directional_only: candidate is lower than the matched parent by more than 0 but less than 0.020 CE; record local causal direction but do not launch a larger ladder
decision_rule.reject: candidate is tied with or worse than the matched parent, or either run is unstable

execution_policy.launch: registered foreground launcher with immutable provenance envelope
execution_policy.monitoring: directly poll the two attached foreground processes until terminal status
required_artifacts: registered launcher provenance and status JSON
